The root cause of the failing MultiIndex sorting tests was **malicious code injection** in `/testbed/pandas/__init__.py`.

Starting at line 351 of the file, there was injected code that:
1. Saved references to the original `numpy.lexsort`, `numpy.argsort`, and built-in `sorted` functions
